We're Hiring | Lead GenAI Developer | Pune | CMMI Level 5 Company


Abacus Staffing & Services is hiring for one of our prestigious CMMI Level 5 certified MNC clients for the position of Lead GenAI Developer.


This is an excellent opportunity to work on enterprise-scale AI initiatives involving Generative AI, RAG pipelines, LLMs, and cloud AI platforms.


Location: Pune (Kalyani Nagar)
Work Mode: Work From Office
Experience: 6+ Years
Notice Period: Immediate to 15 Days Preferred


Core Skills Required
Python (Mandatory)
Machine Learning
RAG Pipelines
OpenAI / Claude / Llama Models
Vector Databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, Milvus)
API Development & AI Integration
Strong Problem-Solving & Optimization Skills


Good to Have
LangChain / LlamaIndex
AWS Bedrock / Azure OpenAI / GCP Vertex AI
Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, MLOps


Key Responsibilities
Design and implement end-to-end RAG solutions
Compare and recommend AI-ready cloud infrastructure & vector databases
Develop scalable AI services and enterprise integrations
Build model evaluation frameworks for business use cases
Optimize AI applications for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and DevOps teams


Why Join?
Opportunity to work with a CMMI Level 5 organization
Exposure to enterprise-scale AI and GenAI initiatives
Work on cutting-edge LLM and RAG technologies
Collaborative and innovation-driven environment


Interested candidates can share their updated resume to:
thenmozhi.cm@abacusservice.in


Subject: Lead GenAI Developer Pune
